title: The Choir
summary: Expedition to the Choir Field (E8). Meet the Choir at its loop, read the code wall (a redacted fragment of the Closing Clause), clear the Spitters there and listen to the tower with a Sensor Mast.

objectives.text: Find the Choir's loop in the north
Read the wall of code in the south-east
Drive off the Spitters at the wall
Build a Sensor Mast to hear the tower
